title: Block coordinate values
statement: For a natural number $m$, an index $b$ in $\{0,\ldots,m-1\}$, and an index $j$ in $\{0,\ldots,2m-1\}$, define a natural-number coordinate value as follows: if $j<m$, it is $bm+j$; otherwise, it is $m^2+bm+(j-m)$.
